title: Circular import detection
description: Detect circular imports between packs before they cause runtime failures.
expected_behavior: SkillsRegistry.detect_circular_dependencies() finds cycles in the dependency graph. FactoryRegistry._check_circular detects import cycles.

test_steps.action: register two packs with circular capability dependencies (A depends on B, B depends on A)
register a pack with no circular deps and run detection

test_steps.expected: returns list (may be empty or contain cycles)
